Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

District.reason: District Line: Severe delays between High Street Kensington and Richmond, and between Kensington(Olympia) and Upminster due to an earlier signal system failure and heat-related temporary speed restrictions. Tickets will be accepted London Buses, Mildmay Line, DLR, Elizabeth line, c2c and South Western Railway services. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Monday 22, Tuesday 23 and Thursday 25 June, the 2147 Clapham Junction to Stratford train will not operate. Trains at 2203 and 2234 from Clapham Junction and 2148 and 2249 from Richmond terminate at Willesden Junction instead of Stratford.

Northern.reason: Northern Line: Severe delays between Camden Town and Kennington via Charing Cross due to earlier faulty train at Camden Town. Tickets being accepted on London Buses. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Tram.reason: London Tramlink: No service between Therapia lane and Mitcham Junction while we fix a fault with the overhead power lines at Mitcham Junction. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
